role: OBSERVED-ONLY runtime experiment. No training. No weight changes. Tests whether SFT6's residual selection failures are caused by candidate-specific priors removable by counterfactual query normalization.
hypothesis: SFT6's residual selection failures are partly caused by candidate-specific prior bias. Subtracting each candidate's counterfactual-query baseline will increase corresponding-value selection without changing model weights.

parent_model.note: SFT6 stays the causal reference (strongest established query-conditioned signal + existing decomposition). SFT7 may be a secondary comparison later.

arms: RAW: full-sequence candidate argmax under the ACTUAL query
CONSTRAINED: greedy restricted to candidate-code continuations
NORMALIZED: argmax of ADJ_i = logP(v_i|actual_query) - mean_{j!=i} logP(v_i|q_j) over counterfactual queries q_j
NORM_EXACT: NORMALIZED selection + emit the selected observed candidate exactly
observed_only_contract: candidate set extracted exclusively from supplied context
gold answer never enters arm construction
hidden labels never enter intervention selection
prompts byte-identical across arms where applicable

pre_registered_predictions.PR1_normalized_beats_raw: NORMALIZED selection accuracy > RAW candidate argmax accuracy on QIM-v5 (paired, per-target)
pre_registered_predictions.PR2_repairs_selection_failures: NORMALIZED converts >= 15% of targets where RAW picked a wrong candidate into correct selections
pre_registered_predictions.PR3_regressions_bounded: pass->fail transitions under NORMALIZED vs RAW <= 3 targets
pre_registered_predictions.PR4_realization_gap_quantified: NORM_EXACT minus NORMALIZED equals exactly the count of normalized-correct-but-free-realization-failure items (identity must hold)
pre_registered_predictions.PR5_format_consistency: improvement appears on both prose and table formats (same direction)
pre_registered_predictions.PR6_fact_count_consistency: effect direction consistent across k=2/3/4 fact counts
pre_registered_predictions.PR7_observed_only: arm construction uses no gold and no hidden labels; verified by construction audit in the runner

falsification: If NORMALIZED does not beat RAW on QIM-v5, the candidate-prior-bias hypothesis for SFT6's residual selection failures is WEAKENED/REJECTED; do not modify the rule post hoc.

decision_tree.CASE_A_normalization_works: candidate-prior/calibration bottleneck confirmed => promote runtime intervention experimentally; DO NOT TRAIN
decision_tree.CASE_B_normalization_fails: selection computation still missing => self-model learns when constrained decode applies; investigate selection without training
decision_tree.note: training remains a last resort requiring runtime-intervention failure on a coherent residual + specific missing-computation hypothesis

verified_intervention_experiences_note: any VIE candidates produced require provenance-complete records (commit, dirty flag, checkpoint SHA, tokenizer identity, device/dtype/decode config) before qualification; count stays 0 until formally judged
